arguments.message:
Hi there,

When an import finishes, the main screen only shows a high‑level count. To see which rows were skipped and why, go to **Settings → Data → Import history**, select the import run you just performed, and review the per‑row results. The history view lists a reason for every row that didn’t import (e.g., missing required field, malformed email, duplicate, etc.).

Fix the issues shown for those rows and then re‑run the import using just the corrected rows. This will avoid re‑processing the rows that already succeeded.

Let me know if you need any more help!
